trans-unit.source: Your account is waiting for approval
Your account has been registered and is waiting for an administrator to approve it. You will get an e-mail with a link to sign in once it is active.
trans-unit.target: Twoje konto zostało zarejestrowane i czeka na zatwierdzenie przez administratora. Gdy konto będzie aktywne, dostaniesz e-mail z linkiem do logowania.
